title: Remote Access and Controls Help Desk Entitlements by Tier of the Building Automation Service Plans

# Remote Access and Controls Help Desk Entitlements by Tier of the Building Automation Service Plans

Each tier of the Building Automation Service Plans fixes whether a remote connection into the site's controls system is included, the annual fee for the secure remote access gateway, the hours the controls help desk answers, the target to answer or call back a controls question, whether a remote attempt to clear a fault is included, the remote and help desk hours included per plan year and the rate billed for controls support hours beyond that pool.

| Tier | Remote access | Gateway fee (USD per year) | Help desk hours | Phone response target (elapsed minutes) | Remote fix attempt | Support hours included per plan year | Support hour rate beyond the pool (USD per hour) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | not included | 0 | business hours | 240 | not included | 4 | 168 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | included | 480 | business hours | 120 | included | 8 | 162 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | included | 480 | extended hours | 60 | included | 16 | 156 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | included | 420 | extended hours | 60 | included | 24 | 150 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | included | 420 | around the clock | 30 | included | 48 | 144 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | included | 0 | around the clock | 15 | included | 120 | 138 |

### Questions the desk answers from this table

**Which tiers carry no gateway fee?** The Controls Help Desk Subscription, because it includes no remote access at all, and the Integrated Building Automation Partnership, where the gateway is carried at 0 USD a year within the plan.

**Which tiers answer outside business hours?** The Scheduled Controls Service Plan and the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan answer extended hours; the Remote Optimization Plan and the Integrated Building Automation Partnership answer around the clock.

**What is the support hour pool worth in money at a given tier?** As a hypothetical, the 16 included hours of the Scheduled Controls Service Plan, priced at that tier's rate of 156 USD an hour, would otherwise cost 2496 USD; the figure is illustrative of the entitlement's size only.
